reason: V4-06 — À faire — Tâche ou Dépense is audit-accepted WITH a delta and zero must-fix findings. The Auditor verified that app/(tabs)/todos.tsx now exposes a Tâche|Dépense kind selector, collects planned expense amount/currency, and completes either kind through completeTodoAtomic, which runs planTodoCompletion and then persists todo.update + contributions.create OR todo.update + expenses.create inside a single repos.withTransaction (rollback proven by failure injection, retry cannot duplicate). Task completion confirms performer/value/beneficiaries; expense completion confirms payer/amount/currency/participants; equal/custom splits are snapshotted on the ledger entry; optional note/photo are carried through. i18n FR/EN keys (todos.kindTask = Tâche/Task, todos.kindExpense = Dépense/Expense, plannedAmount, completeTaskTitle, completeExpenseTitle) have correct French accents and 'Contribution' is absent from the screen. Trusted verification is exit 0: typecheck PASS, 30 suites / 619 Jest tests PASS (up from 600/29; +14 V4-06 tests), privacy release contract PASS (71), cost regression gates PASS (21), i18n PASS (9), Expo Android export PASS (bundled 1337 modules). Previously accepted V4-01..V4-05 and all V3 foundations are preserved. The next coherent criterion from docs/ROADMAP.md is V4-07 — Sync, pièces jointes, privacy et coût. This is NOT optional polish: the current delta-only sync (SYNC_COLLECTIONS in src/domain/services/syncEngine.ts) covers only contribution_entries, expense_entries, settlements, todo_items, persistent_tasks, members, memberships and households — user-created categories, invitations and photo/attachment metadata are not yet sync collections and SyncMaterializer has no materialization/delete case for them. V4-07 must actually deliver delta-only sync and deterministic conflict behavior for categories, named members, invitations, notes/photos and todo-expense; keep photos lazy (bounded metadata only, no bulk history download); preserve strict tenant isolation; extend the privacy pipeline so notes, photo references, raw category labels and operational IDs never leave the operational store (categories normalized downstream only); and extend the cost regression gate to categories, members, invitations, notes/photos and todo-expense. Capturing facts once and treating analytics asynchronously/incrementally stays mandatory. V4-08 carries the full states/visual/legal/accessibility polish AND the cost regression gate; V4-09 final completion belongs exclusively to the trusted release finalizer after privacy/cost/APK/install/golden-path evidence.
